It's an expression of generosity, kindness, and enlightenment, which are highly valued traits in Islamic culture. Fadia signifies the generous soul who gives not only her material possessions but also her time, knowledge, and wisdom to others. It is a reminder of the Prophetic saying, "Give food even if it is only a cup of milk, for it eliminates the hunger and (pleases) Allah."
